dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Yeah, I'm looking for this girl who has the ears and tail of a badger.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: But the ears and tail don't actually grow from her body — they're just part of her outfit.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Her name is Sayu. She is a little ninja from the Kamisato Clan of the Yashiro Commission. She always disappears to slack off if she gets a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Kano Nana
dialogues.text: Some say that the big tail on her outfit has lots of ninjutsu items hidden inside, which can help her hide... Alas, that's a big headache for anyone who is in charge of looking for her, like me.
